g.text: KALAKAR SETU (कलाकार सेतु)
How the App Works • Simple Step-by-Step Flowchart for Everyone
🎙️ Voice Guide + Safe Pay
🇮🇳 Easy 3 Roles
01. OPEN APP & START
Tap [ 🎧 शुरू करें • Start ] to unlock audio & hear voice helper
02. LOGIN WITH MOBILE NUMBER
Enter phone number & 6-digit SMS code [🔊 Audio Guide] • ⚡ 1-Tap Demo
Choose who you are: [ 🎨 Maker / Artisan ] • [ 🛍️ Buyer ] • [ 🤝 Helper ]
ROLE A: MAKER / ARTISAN (कारीगर)
Potters • Weavers • Wood Carvers • Painters
03. Artisan Home Screen
• See new customer orders waiting to be made
• See your earnings & safe bank balance (₹)
04. Take Photo of Craft
• Phone camera guides you with simple outline
• Easily snap front and close-up pictures
05. Clean Background (AI)
• Automatically removes messy room clutter
• Turns into a clean white studio photo
06. Speak in Your Mother Tongue
• Speak freely in Hindi or your village language
• Tell how many hours it took and clay/colors used
• App writes English and Hindi product details
07. Fair Price Calculator
• Adds material cost + hours of hard work
• You get full ₹95 out of every ₹100 earned
08. Original Craft Badge (GI Tag)
• Government badge proving it is 100% genuine
• Shows your name and village as the true maker
09. Put in Store with 1 Tap
• Product is now live for all buyers across India
• Bank linked to get paid directly
ROLE B: BUYER / CUSTOMER (खरीदार)
Craft Lovers • Home Decor • Corporate Gifting
03. Browse Indian Crafts
• Discover handmade pottery, silks & brass art
• Find festive gift hampers & unique village crafts
04. View Photos & Hear Story
• Zoom into clear, high-resolution craft photos
• Press [ 🔊 Listen ] to hear the artisan's voice
05. Check Original Stamp
• Check government GI seal (No fake plastic items)
• See maker photo, state and village name
06. Shopping Cart & Fair Bill
• Select quantity and colors
• Fair Bill: ₹95 of ₹100 goes directly to maker
• Zero secret middleman commissions
07. Enter Delivery Address
• Delivers to any pincode across India by India Post
• Option to add company GST bill for bulk gifts
08. Pay Safely (Money Locked)
• Pay by Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm or Card
• Money stays 100% safe until parcel arrives in hand
09. Track Parcel to Your Door
• 4 Easy Steps: Packed ➔ Dispatched ➔ On Way ➔ Done
• Real-time India Post SpeedPost tracking updates
ROLE C: VILLAGE HELPER (सहयोगी)
SHG Group Leaders • Village Volunteers • Quality Helpers
03. Village Work Monitor
• See total crafts being made across the village
• Make sure orders are finished on time
04. Help Elderly Artisans
• Help older weavers and potters use the app
• Link their bank account and take their voice story
05. Share Big Orders
• Divide a big 1,000-piece order among 15 families
• No single artisan is overworked; everyone earns
06. Advance Raw Materials
• Give clay, yarn or brass before work starts
• Artisans don't need to take expensive loans
• Settled cleanly once customer pays
07. Quality & Packing Check
• Check that size, paint and finish are perfect
• Pack safely in strong boxes so nothing breaks
08. Share Work if Sick
• If an artisan gets sick or bad weather stops work
• 1-Tap pass remaining work to a nearby friend
09. Handover to India Post
• Give all packed boxes to post office together
• Scan postal barcode to begin live tracking
KALAKAR SETU • SAFE PAYMENT & DELIVERY SYSTEM
Buyer gets genuine handmade crafts • Maker gets paid fairly without middlemen
1. Instant Money to Maker (₹95%)
• Customer gets parcel & enters delivery OTP
• Money sends directly to artisan's bank in 5 sec
• No waiting for months to receive payment
2. Real Handmade Certificate
• Buyer gets a digital certificate with QR code
• Scan to see maker's photo, village & video
• 100% proof that it is genuine handmade
3. Good Reviews & Bank Loans
• Buyer leaves 5-star review and tips the artisan
• Village helper gets small 3% support fee
• Artisan builds credit to get easy bank loans

Made with simple words so everyone can easily understand how Kalakar Setu works.
SIH 2025 • Kalakar Setu
